metadata.content:
*You call forth one of the Great Tree's many splinters to provide for your every need.*

| **Green, Magic, [Ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged)** | **Main action** |
|--------------------------|----------------:|
| **📏 [Ranged](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/ranged) 10**         |  **🎯 Special** |

**Effect:** A [size](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.character/size) 5 tree appears in an unoccupied space within [distance](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/distance). The tree has 100 [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina) and can't be [force moved](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/movement/forced-movement). You and any ally can touch the tree to use the [Catch Breath](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.common.maneuvers/catch-breath) maneuver as a [free maneuver](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/free-maneuver). Additionally, when you start your [turn](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn) with [line of effect](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/line-of-effect) to the tree, you can end one effect on yourself that is ended by a [saving throw](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.general/saving-throw) or that ends at the end of your [turn](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn), or you can stand up if you [are prone](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/prone). Each ally within [distance](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/distance) also gains this benefit.

Each enemy who ends their [turn](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn) within 3 squares of the tree is [restrained](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/restrained) until the end of their next [turn](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn). A creature [restrained](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/restrained) this way can use a main action to end the effect early.
